items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I know that George was telling me about when uh...Johnny Dunn came through there. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: But they played more music than the fellas was playing here. Yeah. The fellas there was playing more hit music, you understand. Yeah. In other words uh...whatever comes to their mind that's what they would make.
I know that George was telling me about when uh...Johnny Dunn came through there.
